data.name: Chronicles of Zimoria
data.detailed_description:
Chronicles of Zimoria is an upcoming creature-catching RPG set in the magical and mysterious world of Zimoria. Begin your adventure as an aspiring new Zimon Tamer, choosing your own path through one of three branching storylines—each filled with unique challenges, regions, and secrets.

Explore nine visually distinct regions across Zimoria, from peaceful sunlit meadows to the eerie depths of the Shadow Realm. Along the way, help solve problems of the residents in each region to gain their trust and support to learn more about the past and legends of Zimoria and fill your ZiPidea by discovering and documenting over 150 unique Zimon species.

But danger lurks beneath the surface. The secretive Cult of the Marionette is working to resurrect the long-banished Puppet Master—an ancient evil whose return could plunge Zimoria into darkness once more. Only you can uncover the truth, stop their dark plans, and determine the fate of this legendary land.

Chronicles of Zimoria features a fast-paced, turn, strategic timeline-based battle system built around bonded teamwork and tactical decision-making.

  • Build your dream team from over 150 unique Zimon, each with their own elemental type, signature abilities, and personality traits. Recruit them after defeating in battle and expand your roster as you journey across Zimoria.

  • In battle, you fight using Bonded Pairs — a Human character and their partnered Zimon acting together as a single tactical unit. Each pair takes turns on a shared battle timeline, where positioning, timing, and move choice determine the flow of combat.

  • On each turn, you can choose how your pair acts: command human skills, unleash Zimon abilities, or trigger unique Combo Attacks based on their class and elemental synergy. Every combination creates different tactical opportunities, from raw damage and defense to status effects, healing, and battlefield control.

  • Master the MT-based timeline system, where every action affects when your next turn arrives. Faster decisions, lighter abilities, and smart synergy use can shift momentum in your favor — while powerful attacks may leave you temporarily exposed.

  • Experiment with different Human classes, Zimon elements, and pair combinations to discover powerful synergies and unlock new combat strategies as you progress across the landscape of Zimoria.

Your journey begins in the small tranquil village of Quietbrook, where you've spent your childhood studying Zimon taming under the guidance of your father, a researcher who is interested in Zimoria's past and legends. But just as you’re ready to take your tamer test to be an official tamer of Zimon, your father vanishes while researching at a battle challenge in the capital—and nothing is ever the same again.

Set out on an unforgettable quest to uncover the truth behind your father’s disappearance, unravel the sinister motives of the Cult of the Marionette, and rise through the ranks of tamers in a land where every decision matters.

Explore nine diverse environments, each filled with villages, routes, hidden secrets, and side quests to develop Quietbrook and find out the truth. Whether you're investigating ancient ruins, navigating haunted woods, or confronting the darkness of the Shadow Realm, Chronicles of Zimoria offers a narrative rich with twists, choices, and lasting consequences.

  • Lillie – Your neighbor and childhood friend, Lillie had always dreamed of exploring the world of Zimoria alongside her Zimon partner. Cheerful, competitive, and endlessly curious, she’s always by your side during the journey—but don’t underestimate her skills as a tamer!

  • Aiden – Lillie’s older brother and a seasoned Zimon tamer. Ambitious and fiercely protective, Aiden is driven by a desire to prove himself—sometimes at the cost of empathy. Beneath his hardened exterior lies a deeper story waiting to unfold.

  • The Puppet Master – The mysterious leader of the Cult of the Marionette, cloaked in secrecy and legend. His goal? To revive the ancient power he once wielded and claim dominion over Zimoria once again.

We’re so excited to bring you Chronicles of Zimoria, a project born from a deep love for classic creature-catching RPGs and the worlds they let us escape to. Our mission was to capture the magic of those timeless games while adding modern depth, branching stories, and original mechanics that feel fresh and rewarding.

Every part of this game has been crafted with care—from the lore and characters to the battle systems and world design. We can’t wait for you to explore Zimoria, meet your new favorite Zimon, and forge your own unforgettable adventure.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us!
